query_1.cypher_query: match (s:MicrobiotaName)-[r:significantly_associated]->(o:FE{name:"FE"}) where s.name in ["Clostridium","Lactobacillus","Oscillibacter"] return s

query_2.description: 能够减少这些微生物群数量的基因表达
query_2.sql_query: Select Distinct gene_symbol,relationship from has_expression_change_results_by_microbiota hecrbm join gutmgene.gut_microbiota_gene_change_results gmgcr where hecrbm.`index` = gmgcr.`index` and gmgcr.Alteration = 'decrease' and relationship in ('Clostridium','Lactobacillus','Oscillibacter')

query_1.description: 在人类宿主中，药物Synbiotic导致肠道微生物丰度上升的微生物
